subject.title: MercadoLibre keeps active listings for stocks withdrawn before snapshot

question: Should Marketplace proceed with a guarded MercadoLibre reconciliation/backfill for orphan item IDs, followed by enabling or reviewing local `recoverWithdraw` for the recoverable backlog?
rationale: The evidence points to a real over-sale risk, but the corrective path mutates marketplace state at scale and AGENTS.md requires human confirmation for this class of operation.

options.title: Run guarded reconciliation first
options.body: Build or run a dry-run reconciler from snapshot/API item IDs by SKU, review samples, then close or rehydrate orphan listings and address local withdraw recovery.

options.title: Only enable local recoverWithdraw
options.body: This is narrower and faster, but the triage data says it leaves the majority of orphan listings without local docs unresolved.

options.title: Consolidate under the older report
options.body: Track the work under https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/6859 only if this issue's newer orphan-listing evidence is copied or linked there.

recommendation.title: Run guarded reconciliation first
recommendation.body: Build or run a dry-run reconciler from snapshot/API item IDs by SKU, review samples, then close or rehydrate orphan listings and address local withdraw recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the current live evidence and recently worked on MercadoLibre withdraw observability, so he is the best visible owner for the operational go/no-go.
